# Perspective depth-of-field comparisons

Five original GPL-3.0-only camera scenes isolate zero lens radius, a plane at
focus, a shifted focus plane, PBRT's omitted `focaldistance` default (1e6), and
an EWA-filtered native RGB8 chart at focused and defocused depths. The chart is
procedurally generated by `generate_projection_samples.pattern_png`; it is an
owned geometric image with no external image inputs.

`cornell-focus.pbrt` is a **labeled CC0 derivative**, preserving the geometry and
material/area-light adaptations in `../cornell-box-adapted.pbrt` and adding
`lensradius=.12`, `focaldistance=6.8`. The original scene is by Benedikt Bitterli,
with PBRT v4 conversion credited to Matt Pharr. The pinned original, adapted
source hashes, changes and unchanged notice are recorded in `provenance.json`.
This selected derivative does not establish unmodified upstream corpus support.

`manifest.json` hashes every authored entry. `dependencies.json` records the
complete entry-relative closure, including the Cornell notice, checked before
staging relocated variants. `provenance.json` records authorship, terms, pinned
PBRT revision and external source lineage. No external downloads are needed.

Run from the repository root, after building the pinned reference and rypath
reference executable:

```sh
python3 scripts/compare_depth_of_field.py \
  --rypath build/debug/rypath_pbrt_reference \
  --output-dir build/depth-of-field-comparison
```

The 24 fixed cases combine all six scenes with box radius .5 / triangle radius
1 and independent / randomized Sobol `fastowen`. `--scene` selects authored
scenes; `--case` selects exact case names (see `--help`). These are declared
filter/sampler variants; camera, geometry, texture and lighting are identical
between backends. PBRT explicitly uses world render coordinates and two threads.
Every case uses 8×8 pixels, 4,096 spp, CIE1931, ISO100, full-float linear RGB,
16 rypath seeds 0–15 and 16 disjoint PBRT seeds 16–31. Five regions (full image
and four quadrants) each gate all RGB channels using independent replicate means:

```
abs(mean_rypath - mean_pbrt) <=
  5 * sqrt(var_rypath / 16 + var_pbrt / 16) + 2e-5 * max(1, abs(mean_pbrt))
```

Each backend must also have a positive full-image mean RGB sum; agreement
between black outputs is rejected. This gate and case set were chosen before rendering. Randomized Sobol uses one
independent randomization per seed; correlated pixels never count as independent
replicates. The tool retains variants, raw PFMs, process commands, stdout/stderr,
measurements, hashes, effective overrides and JSON summary. Reported ERROR/FATAL/
SEVERE diagnostics reject a render even if its process exits zero. `--pbrt-only`
checks reference inputs and positive signal; it makes no agreement claim.

`generate_depth_of_field_samples.py --output-dir DIRECTORY` only writes three
matched original 768×512, 512-spp showcase scenes and a deterministic image chart.
`pinhole`, `focus-near` and `focus-far` retain identical geometry, sampler and
lighting; only lens radius and axial focus distance change. No renderer is
invoked by the generator. Images and comparison measurements are build artifacts,
not fixture inputs or historical validation claims.
